verses.text: How terrible it will be for the city of oppressors, rebellious and unclean!
She does not obey anyone. She does not accept correction. She does not trust in the LORD. She does not come near her God.
Her officials are roaring lions. Her judges are wolves at dusk that leave nothing for the morning.
Her prophets are proud and cannot be trusted. Her priests make the holy place unholy and twist the law.
The LORD within her is righteous. He does nothing wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light, and every new day he does not fail. But the wicked know no shame.
"I have wiped out nations. Their towers lie in ruins. I have left their streets empty, with no one walking in them. Their cities are destroyed, and no one lives there.

I said to the city, 'Surely you will fear me and accept correction!' Then her home would not have been destroyed, and all my punishments would not have come on her. But they were even more eager to do every kind of evil.

"So wait for me," says the LORD, "for the day I will stand up to accuse. I have decided to gather the nations and bring the kingdoms together. I will pour out my anger on them, all my fierce fury. The whole earth will be burned up by the fire of my jealous anger.
"Then I will purify the lips of the peoples, so that all of them may call on the name of the LORD and serve him together, side by side.
From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, my scattered people, will bring offerings to me.
On that day you will not be put to shame for all the wrongs you have done against me. I will remove from among you those who brag and boast. You will never again be proud on my holy mountain.
But I will leave among you people who are humble and poor. They will trust in the name of the LORD.
The survivors of Israel will do no wrong. They will tell no lies, and no deceit will be found in their mouths. They will eat and lie down in peace, and no one will make them afraid."
Sing, people of Zion! Shout aloud, Israel! Be glad and celebrate with all your heart, people of Jerusalem!
The LORD has taken away your punishment. He has turned back your enemy. The LORD, the King of Israel, is with you. You will never again fear any harm.
On that day people will say to Jerusalem, "Do not be afraid, Zion. Do not let your hands hang limp.
The LORD your God is with you. He is a mighty warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you. He will quiet you with his love. He will celebrate over you with singing."
"I will take away the sorrow of those who mourn because they cannot attend the appointed festivals. That sorrow has been a burden and a disgrace to you.
At that time I will deal with all who oppressed you. I will rescue the lame and gather those who were scattered. I will give them praise and honor in every land where they were put to shame.
At that time I will gather you and bring you home. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I bring back your good fortune before your very eyes," says the LORD.
